title: Deepfake DCP resigns; Rath Yatra passed off as protest
situation: A deepfake shows a DCP "resigning" because he was told to frame students; a Rath Yatra crowd video is passed off as Jantar Mantar; Delhi Police rebut 15 posts (girl died in stampede, nail batons, etc.) and allege "Pakistan-based handlers".

lines.text: The viral clip is completely fake and has already been rebutted.
lines.speaker: police source

lines.text: Pakistan-based handlers allegedly modulated the voice and inserted fabricated audio.
lines.speaker: police source

context: ThePrint (Oct 9) notes a July police fact-check denying pellet use was later contradicted by reports the RAF fired pellets.

buildThis.situation: Rumour system: a fake "Rao resigns" clip spreads at 15:00; Zoya can debunk it on air, or the player can push it and watch the line waver.
